text_en: Paul went on also to Derbe and to Lystra, where there was a disciple named Timothy, the son of a Jewish woman who was a believer; but his father was a Greek.
text_cn: 保禄来到了德尔贝和吕斯特辣。在那里有个门徒，名叫弟茂德，是一个信主的犹太妇人的儿子，父亲却是希腊人，

text_en: He was well spoken of by the believers in Lystra and Iconium.
text_cn: 在吕斯特辣及依科尼雍的弟兄们都称扬他。

text_en: Paul wanted Timothy to accompany him; and he took him and had him circumcised because of the Jews who were in those places, for they all knew that his father was a Greek.
text_cn: 保禄愿意他随自己同去，为了那些地方的犹太人的缘故，带他去行了割损礼，因为众人都知道他的父亲是希腊人。

text_en: As they went from town to town, they delivered to them for observance the decisions that had been reached by the apostles and elders who were in Jerusalem.
text_cn: 当他们经过各城时，就将宗徒和长老在耶路撒冷所议定的规条，交给他们遵守；

text_en: So the churches were strengthened in the faith and increased in numbers daily.
text_cn: 于是各处教会信德稳固，数目天天增加。

text_en: They went through the region of Phrygia and Galatia, having been forbidden by the Holy Spirit to speak the word in Asia.
text_cn: 圣神既阻止他们在亚细亚讲道，他们就经过夫黎基雅和迦拉达地区，

text_en: When they had come opposite Mysia, they attempted to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit of Jesus did not allow them;
text_cn: 到了米息雅附近，想往彼提尼雅去；可是耶稣的神不许他们去，

text_en: so, passing by Mysia, they went down to Troas.
text_cn: 遂绕过米息雅，下到了特洛阿。

text_en: During the night Paul had a vision: there stood a man of Macedonia pleading with him and saying, “Come over to Macedonia and help us. ”
text_cn: 夜间保禄见了一个异象，有个马其顿人站着，请求他说：“请往马其顿去，援助我们罢！”

text_en: When he had seen the vision, we immediately tried to cross over to Macedonia, being convinced that God had called us to proclaim the good news to them.
text_cn: 保禄既见了这异象，我们便推知是天主召叫我们给他们宣传福音，便立即设法往马其顿去。

text_en: We set sail from Troas and took a straight course to Samothrace, the following day to Neapolis,
text_cn: 我们从特洛阿开船，一直航到撒摩辣刻，第二天到了乃阿颇里，

text_en: and from there to Philippi, which is a leading city of the district of Macedonia and a Roman colony. We remained in this city for some days.
text_cn: 从那里到了斐理伯，这是马其顿一区的首城，罗马的殖民地。我们就在这城里住了几天。

text_en: On the sabbath day we went outside the gate by the river, where we supposed there was a place of prayer; and we sat down and spoke to the women who had gathered there.
text_cn: 安息日，我们出了城门，到了河边，我们知道那里有个祈祷所。我们遂坐下向聚集的妇女讲话。

text_en: A certain woman named Lydia, a worshiper of God, was listening to us; she was from the city of Thyatira and a dealer in purple cloth. The Lord opened her heart to listen eagerly to what was said by Paul.
text_cn: 有个敬畏天主的女人，名叫里狄雅，是提雅提辣城卖紫红布的，她一直在听；主开明了她的心，使她接受保禄所讲的话。

text_en: When she and her household were baptized, she urged us, saying, “If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come and stay at my home. ” And she prevailed upon us.
text_cn: 她同她一家领了洗，便请求说：“你们若认为我是忠于主的人，就请到我家去住。”遂强邀我们去了。

text_en: One day, as we were going to the place of prayer, we met a slave-girl who had a spirit of divination and brought her owners a great deal of money by fortune-telling.
text_cn: 当我们往祈祷所去时，有个附占卜之神的女孩，向我们迎面走来；她行占卜，使她的主人们大获利润。

text_en: While she followed Paul and us, she would cry out, “These men are slaves of the Most High God, who proclaim to you a way of salvation. ”
text_cn: 她跟着保禄和我们，喊叫说：“这些人是至高者天主的仆人，他们来给你们宣布得救的道路。”

text_en: She kept doing this for many days. But Paul, very much annoyed, turned and said to the spirit, “I order you in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her. ” And it came out that very hour.
text_cn: 她这样行了多日，保禄就厌烦了，转身向那恶神说：“我因耶稣基督之名，命你从她身上出去。”那恶神即刻便出去了。

text_en: But when her owners saw that their hope of making money was gone, they seized Paul and Silas and dragged them into the marketplace before the authorities.
text_cn: 她的主人们见自己获利的指望已去，便揪住保禄和息拉，拉到街市上去见首领；

text_en: When they had brought them before the magistrates, they said, “These men are disturbing our city; they are Jews
text_cn: 又带他们到官长前说：“这些是犹太人，他们扰乱我们的城市，

text_en: and are advocating customs that are not lawful for us as Romans to adopt or observe. ”
text_cn: 竟传布我们罗马人所不能接受，也不能遵行的规例。”

text_en: The crowd joined in attacking them, and the magistrates had them stripped of their clothing and ordered them to be beaten with rods.
text_cn: 群众齐来攻击他们，官长就撕下了他们的衣服，下令用棍殴打。

text_en: After they had given them a severe flogging, they threw them into prison and ordered the jailer to keep them securely.
text_cn: 打了许多棍之后，就把他们押在监里，吩咐狱警小心看守；

text_en: Following these instructions, he put them in the innermost cell and fastened their feet in the stocks.
text_cn: 狱警领命，就把他们下在内监，又在他们的脚上带上木枷。

text_en: About midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the prisoners were listening to them.
text_cn: 约在半夜时分，保禄和息拉祈祷赞颂天主，囚犯都侧耳静听。

text_en: Suddenly there was an earthquake, so violent that the foundations of the prison were shaken; and immediately all the doors were opened and everyone’s chains were unfastened.
text_cn: 忽然地震大作，甚至监狱地基都摇动了，所有的门立时开了，众人的锁链也解开了。

text_en: When the jailer woke up and saw the prison doors wide open, he drew his sword and was about to kill himself, since he supposed that the prisoners had escaped.
text_cn: 狱警醒来，见监门全开着，以为囚犯都已逃走，就拔出剑来，想要自杀。

text_en: But Paul shouted in a loud voice, “Do not harm yourself, for we are all here. ”
text_cn: 保禄大声喊说：“不要伤害自己，我们还都在这里。”

text_en: The jailer called for lights, and rushing in, he fell down trembling before Paul and Silas.
text_cn: 狱警要来了灯，就跑进去，战栗发抖地俯伏在保禄和息拉面前，

text_en: Then he brought them outside and said, “Sirs, what must I do to be saved? ”
text_cn: 然后领他们出来说：“先生，我当作什么才可得救？”

text_en: They answered, “Believe on the Lord Jesus, and you will be saved, you and your household. ”
text_cn: 他们说：“你信主耶稣罢！你和你一家就必得救。”

text_en: They spoke the word of the Lord to him and to all who were in his house.
text_cn: 他们就给他和他家所有的人，讲了主的圣道。

text_en: At the same hour of the night he took them and washed their wounds; then he and his entire family were baptized without delay.
text_cn: 当夜在那时刻，狱警就带他们去洗伤，他和他的亲人也都领了洗；

text_en: He brought them up into the house and set food before them; and he and his entire household rejoiced that he had become a believer in God.
text_cn: 遂又领他们到自己家里，摆了宴席；他和全家因信了天主，都满心喜欢。

text_en: When morning came, the magistrates sent the police, saying, “Let those men go. ”
text_cn: 到了天亮，官长打发侍卫来说：“释放那些人！”

text_en: And the jailer reported the message to Paul, saying, “The magistrates sent word to let you go; therefore come out now and go in peace. ”
text_cn: 狱警就将这话报告给保禄说：“官长打发人来释放你们，所以现在你们出来，平安去罢！”

text_en: But Paul replied, “They have beaten us in public, uncondemned, men who are Roman citizens, and have thrown us into prison; and now are they going to discharge us in secret? Certainly not! Let them come and take us out themselves. ”
text_cn: 可是保禄向他们说：“我们是罗马人，还没有定罪，就公开鞭打我们，又把我们下在监里；现在却要秘密地赶我们出去吗？绝对不可！他们得亲自来领我们出去！”

text_en: The police reported these words to the magistrates, and they were afraid when they heard that they were Roman citizens;
text_cn: 侍卫就把这话报告给官长，官长一听他们是罗马人，就害怕起来，

text_en: so they came and apologized to them. And they took them out and asked them to leave the city.
text_cn: 遂来向他们说好话，领出后，请求他们离开那城。

text_en: After leaving the prison they went to Lydia’s home; and when they had seen and encouraged the brothers and sisters there, they departed.
text_cn: 二人出了监狱，就进了里狄雅的家，会见了弟兄们，鼓励一番后，便起程走了。
